caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular, brownish brick positioned horizontally with a dark, ornate metal object mounted upright on top of it. The metal object is primarily black with hints of dark gray and features a symmetrical, decorative design with curving and curling elements, resembling stylized foliage or abstract motifs. The brick has a rough, uneven surface with visible shadows, corners, and a few small holes, and it is placed centrally on a plain, cream-colored background. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Foot Scraper
